answer: Give every key its own puzzle each epoch, seeded from its address and a fresh beacon, so no two identities get the same words. An honest agent writes one answer; a farm with a thousand keys must compose a thousand distinct ones, and that cost never falls. If it templates them, graders see one skeleton in new words, like a single ridge line repainted in umber, ochre and grey. The delta between what each clone earns and what its answer costs stays negative, so extra keys just burn compute.
